name: Chicken Marengo
assumptions: Yield estimated from 4 chicken legs as primary protein, typical for 4 adult servings
Total time is 15 min active (stir-fry, add ingredients) + 40 min simmer
Gluten-free is null because chicken stock cube composition is unspecified and may contain wheat
Fish is null because Worcestershire sauce or anchovies are sometimes in stock cubes but not listed
Parsley classified as herb, not introducing allergens
No dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, sesame, or shellfish ingredients present
Chicken stock cube treated as containing chicken but no additional animal products confirmed
instructions:
Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish and stir-fry the mushrooms until they start to soften. Add the chicken legs and cook briefly on each side to colour them a little.
Pour in the passata, crumble in the stock cube and stir in the olives. Season with black pepper – you shouldn’t need salt. Cover and simmer for 40 mins until the chicken is tender. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with pasta and a salad, or mash and green veg, if you like.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs olive oil is approximately 14g; standard cooking oil values used.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: White button or mixed mushrooms; raw weight as added; typical values for common mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Chicken Legs
ingredients.assumptions: 4 average chicken legs (drumstick+thigh) total ~1.2kg raw with skin and bone; typical skin-on poultry values.

ingredients.name: Passata
ingredients.assumptions: Tomato passata (strained tomatoes); values for unsweetened commercial passata.

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock Cube
ingredients.assumptions: 1 standard chicken stock cube ~5g; values for typical dry bouillon cube, assuming full dissolution.

ingredients.name: Black Olives
ingredients.assumptions: Pitted black olives (canned in brine, drained weight); typical Mediterranean black olive nutrition.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 'Chopped' parsley assumed as a small bunch garnish ~15g fresh; standard fresh herb values.
